# Use the Design pack

<!-- Generated by build_pack_guides.py from pack.json and the skills' own files. Edit those, not this. -->

On-brand visual work: capture a brand once, then build real PowerPoint decks and print-ready marketing flyers in that brand, with logo, colours and fonts applied.

**Reach for it when:** You need a deck or a flyer in your own branding and do not want to answer the brand questions every time.

## 1. Install it

```bash
npx skilldrop-cli install --pack design                 # Claude Code, your user folder
npx skilldrop-cli install --pack design --project       # Claude Code, this repo
npx skilldrop-cli install --pack design --ide cursor    # or kiro, codex, antigravity, copilot
npx skilldrop-cli install --pack design --local         # this repo, hidden from git
```

In Claude Code you can also add the marketplace once (`/plugin marketplace add sananthanarayan/skilldrop`) and run `/plugin install design@skilldrop`.

It brings `core` with it, so the shared skills are there too.

## 2. Run the first task: capture your brand once, then make a flyer in it

Before you start:

- Your logo as a PNG file, and your brand colours if you know them

Paste this into your agent:

```text
Set up our brand kit from this logo (./brand/logo.png) and these colours: #0E5A46, #F2A541. Then make a Letter-size flyer for our community health fair on Saturday 14 November, 10am–2pm, at Riverside Park.
```

**How to tell it worked:** brand-kit writes brand.json and a one-page BRAND.md with contrast checked, and marketing-flyer writes flyer.html in your colours with your logo, one call to action, and only the facts you gave it.

**If nothing happens:** If the flyer comes out in default colours, check that marketing-flyer was given the brand.json path. If brand-kit does not activate, ask for it by name ("use brand-kit").

## 3. A typical session

Bring:

- your logo as a PNG, and a white version if you have one
- brand colours, fonts or a PowerPoint template, if you know them
- the content: the doc or points for the deck, and the event facts for a flyer
- the audience and how long you have to present

1. **`brand-kit`**: Hand over your logo, colours and any brand guidelines or template.
   You get: A brand.json and a one-page BRAND.md, with text contrast checked and each value traced to where it came from.
2. **`slide-outliner`**: Give it the content, the audience and the time slot.
   You get: A slide-by-slide outline with takeaway titles, key points, speaker notes, backup slides for likely questions, and a slide-count check against the time.
3. **`deck-builder`**: Hand it the outline, the audience and your brand.json.
   You get: An editable .pptx in your brand, with charts, tables and images where the content calls for them.
4. **`doc-critique`**: Run it on the deck against the deck rubric, as deck-builder recommends.
   You get: A verdict and severity-tagged findings with a fix for each.
   **You decide:** Ship the deck, apply the changes, or rework the outline.
5. **`marketing-flyer`**: If you also need a flyer, give it the event facts and the same brand.json.
   You get: A print-ready flyer.html with one call to action and only the facts you gave it, which you can save to PDF.

You end with: A reusable brand kit, a reviewed on-brand .pptx, and optionally a flyer built from the same brand.
